nodes.description: Public mapping storing token balances of the UniswapExchange token; written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/_mints/batchSend.
Public nested mapping storing allowances between owner and spender in the UniswapExchange token.
Private owner address of the UniswapExchange token; permission gate for privileged functions.
Private mapping whitelisting addresses that bypass the sale condition check in ensure().
Private mapping counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom.
Private minimum sale amount used by condition() as anti-bot threshold.
Private maximum sale amount used by condition() as anti-bot threshold.
Private maximum number of sells allowed per address, checked in condition().
Privileged whitelisted trade address settable by the owner via setTradeAddress.
Constant public decimals value (18) used for scaling mint/sale amounts.
Public total supply of the UniswapExchange token, set in the constructor.
Public token name.
Public token symbol.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate performing address whitelisting and sale-condition validation.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks, ensure() validation and unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-address or race checks.
Internal view anti-bot condition function using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall wrapper executing attacker-supplied calldata in this contract's context.
Privileged mint function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender in canSale.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum used by condition().
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication for total supply deduction.
Owner-only setter that stores an address whitelisted by ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Payable constructor setting name/symbol/owner, minting totalSupply and approving the UNI router.
External caller identity used for authorization and as the implicit source of transfers.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing arbitrary external code with this contract's storage.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in Solidity 0.5, vulnerable to underflow.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in Solidity 0.5, vulnerable to overflow.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length allowing overflow of the deducted total.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue * (10**decimals) defining the arbitrarily set minted balance.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom() checked against whitelisting rules.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom() used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Target address parameter of delegate() for the delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate() forwarded to the delegatecall.
Address parameter of _mints() whose balance is overwritten and which is whitelisted.
Amount parameter of _mints() that is scaled by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
Number of allowed sales parameter of init().
Minimum sale amount parameter of init() scaled into _minSale.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init() scaled into _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend() multiplied by array length.
Address parameter of setTradeAddress() stored as the whitelisted trade address.
Local variable holding _value * _tos.length subject to overflow.
Loop counter local variable of batchSend().
Loop-local recipient address read from _tos in batchSend().

edges.reason: transfer() unconditionally delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate the participant against the whitelist and sale rules.
transferFrom() reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not the source.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful sale.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked addition that can overflow.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() grants a whitelist bypass when _from equals the hardcoded UNI router.
ensure() falls back to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist check.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a lower bound on sale value.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce an upper bound on sale value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-address or race protection.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate() forwards arbitrary attacker-controlled calldata into a delegatecall.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with a scaled value without overflow checks.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a permanent whitelist bypass.
_mints() authorizes the caller via the owner address check.
_mints() computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow protection.
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() writes the scaled minimum sale amount into _minSale.
init() writes the scaled maximum sale amount into _maxSale.
init() writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() deducts the computed total from balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes the caller-supplied address into tradeAddress, a whitelist bypass.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router.
msg.sender determines the allowance spender path and the implicit _from==msg.sender check in transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize the delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender is checked against owner or a hardcoded privileged address in _mints().
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize init().
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize batchSend().
msg.sender is compared to owner to authorize setTradeAddress().
approve() keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom call.
constructor uses msg.sender to set owner and the initial balance.
_to is forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
_value is forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
_from of transferFrom() feeds the ensure() whitelist checks and balance mutations.
_to of transferFrom() receives the credited balance.
_value of transferFrom() is subtracted and added to balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Target address a of delegate() is the delegatecall destination.
Calldata b of delegate() is passed straight into the delegatecall.
spender of _mints() is written into balanceOf and whitelisted via canSale.
addedValue of _mints() is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
saleNum of init() is stored into _saleNum.
token of init() is scaled and stored into _minSale.
maxToken of init() is scaled and stored into _maxSale.
_tos of batchSend() determines the multiplication factor for the total deduction.
_value of batchSend() is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath.
addr of setTradeAddress() becomes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure().
Local total in batchSend() carries the overflowed multiplication result.
Loop counter i in batchSend() drives iteration over the recipient array.
Loop-local _to in batchSend() is credited with the per-recipient value.

Parameter is only used as the amount forwarding argument of transfer().
Parameter is only consumed by the whitelist and balance logic of transferFrom().
Parameter is only consumed by the credit logic of transferFrom().
Parameter directly drives the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom().
Parameter is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter is the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Parameter is only used to key balanceOf and canSale inside _mints().
Parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked mint scaling arithmetic.
Parameter is only stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter is only scaled into _minSale by init().
Parameter is only scaled into _maxSale by init().
Parameter only controls the loop bound and multiplication factor of batchSend().
Parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
Parameter is only written into the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
Local variable holds the result of the unchecked overflow multiplication.
Local loop counter only exists inside batchSend().
Loop-local address only exists inside the batchSend() loop.
